title: Internet (Mac OS 8.6 / 9)
note: Internet clients for the Mac OS 8.6 and 9.0.4 profiles: MR Browser 0.39 (Macintosh Repository's own client; signing in takes an MR account and PIN), Hotline Connect Client 1.9.1 (the classic build and the Carbon one), and Serial MReader 0.03 with the Serial Box 2021-08 database, kept as an archive only. Boots with 8.6 or 9.0.4.
